b.label: Air Force Office of Special Investigations

edges.label: Names AFOSI/PJ, the Office of Special Projects, as an operative node
edges.note: Gerb identifies AFOSI/PJ and its former director Terry Phillips - now Northrop Grumman VP for Security - as a bridge between Air Force counterintelligence and contractor security.

edges.label: Identifies candidates for Mellon's unnamed Air Force SES-2 gatekeeper
edges.note: Gerb proposes that SAF/AAH (Sensitive Activities) and SAF/AZ and their directors Russell Wyler and William Maclure are the likely referents of the Air Force SES-2 gatekeeper Christopher Mellon has described publicly. This is Gerb's method in miniature: take a witness's unnamed role and resolve it against the published org chart.
